corpusClass: private user-supplied real-game ROMs, local evaluation only; no ROM bytes in this artefact
statusRule: the four statuses are independent; motion or a RAM delta promotes nothing, and AGOD_ELIGIBLE requires all three others

statuses.GAMEPLAY_EVIDENCE_NOTE: control of an object is corroborated across RAM and video; the phase remains an inference, not a certainty
statuses.AGOD_ELIGIBLE_SCOPE: core-local: admission to a limited experiment on this jsnes build, with bus conflicts not modelled and the game phase inferred rather than certain. Results must not be transferred to original hardware.

idle.note: context only: an attract screen moves as much as play does, so this promotes nothing

ram.note: ADDRESSES responding bidirectionally, not confirmed coordinates; a menu cursor has the same signature

video.method: differential between the Left and Right arms at equal frame counts from one snapshot, so an identical scrolling background cancels
video.directionNote: the differing pixels of the two arms are one set, so this yields one mean x and cannot say which way an object moved
video.sensitivityNote: a differing-pixel count near the whole screen means the test cannot resolve an object, and is reported as not localised rather than as an object

gameplay.criteria: RAM bidirectionality AND >=4 distinct outcomes across eight buttons AND a localised video difference AND that difference surviving release
gameplay.phaseNote: control of an object is corroborated across RAM and video; the phase remains an inference, not a certainty

mapper.prgBankSwitching: observed working on 8 of 8 banks tested
mapper.fidelityNote: PASS-WITH-DEVIATION describes this local experimental core only and must not be read as NES hardware conformance

statuses.GAMEPLAY_EVIDENCE_NOTE: neither modality indicates object control under this entry procedure; this is an absence of evidence under one procedure, not proof that the cartridge cannot be played
statuses.AGOD_ELIGIBLE_SCOPE: core-local: admission to a limited experiment on this jsnes build, with bus conflicts not modelled and the game phase inferred rather than certain. Results must not be transferred to original hardware.
